text: Lactoferrin is a small fraction of milk protein, so it is fished out of the flow with a cation-exchange column and eluted with salt. Membrane filtration and salt extraction are also used.

steps.note: The whey is run over a resin that holds the lactoferrin.

steps.name: release
steps.note: Salt, sodium chloride, is run through, and cow's lactoferrin comes off at about 0.75 M, a strength of salt.
